added.source: Equivalent aligned FP32-input BF16 Store/Add epilogues: eight rows per thread with vector loads/stores. Preserve FP32 addition and final BF16 rounding, existing workspace/ABI and scalar gated/unaligned/narrow/FP32 routes. Backend implementation only; no new numerical profile or frontend policy.

Backend-owned exact-width Lt512 profile routing with conditional caller-owned workspace; 78 twice-confirmed RTX5060Ti IQ3_S/IQ4_XS shape/epilogue rules. FP32 decode, actual amax, E4M3/E8M0 and FP32 accumulation retained. Public FP64/fusion/Graph boundary qualification; no frontend policy or FP4 change.

Route-owned FP8/Q8 workspace and full token interval planning, adapted from ninfer-5060-qwen@08c4fb70. Existing actual-amax/FP32 arithmetic and routes retained; exact-capacity and independent public-op qualification. NVFP4 retains conservative capacity.

Aligned MXFP8 BF16 Store/Add output adapted from ninfer-5060-qwen@08c4fb70, preserving actual-amax encoding and FP32 gate/up. Output-type-specific Lt cache, BF16 Add capacity and profile-v3 state binding; independent public-op and Graph qualification.

Backend-owned per-device MXFP8 image capacity. Measured32MiB on36SM5060Ti; unknown devices64MiB. Reference10.5MiB rejected for speed. Actual-amax encoding and FP32 gate/up retained; independent CPU/FP64/Graph/memory and fixed-corpus incremental quality gates.

Audit fix for a newly introduced BF16 Add capacity assumption: contiguous public residuals need not be 16-byte aligned. Bound FP32 fallback and independently test exact capacity, gathers and canaries.

finding.origin: New gguf-bf16-output patch, not an inherited backend defect
finding.trigger: Public contiguous BF16 LinearAdd residual at base+2, N=128 K=256 T=512/1024, with and without gather
finding.impact: Valid unaligned residual selects FP32 fallback, while the former capacity query omitted its FP32 plane/scratch: bad allocation
finding.fix: Keep Add-specific route union, reserve the FP32 fallback whenever Lt is possible; aligned execution still uses BF16 direct output. Register dedicated CTest regression.
finding.cost: Capacity query conservatively reserves fallback storage even for aligned residuals. Aggregate model peak and speed were not remeasured after this audit fix; native40 end-to-end measurements remain historical, not final43 package measurements.

scope: Focused same-ABI qualification with frozen CUDA/ops libraries and one replaced host implementation; full 43-patch replay and prepared tree checked. Current master DFlash/shared-cache runtime composition is source-integrated but not a newly built full package.
limitations: No automatic Lt512/image-budget profile calibration added.
No new full composed package, multi-concurrency or other-GPU/model whole-inference qualification.
Native40 rejected 10.5MiB budget cost about 3.5-3.7% throughput; one KVMem1024 baseline had about 4.4% spread, so the 32MiB group mean is not a stable 2.7% speed claim.

Sandbox TEMP/Git atomic-index/local HTTP restrictions invalidated initial host test attempts; all three suites passed with task TEMP and normal permissions.
